description:
After meeting an untimely death, Tomokui Kanata is reincarnated as a lowly goblin, but he’s worked up a monstrous appetite. Thanks to his new ability that allows him to grow stronger the more he feeds, his feeble status quickly changes, and he rises to become the goblin leader. With a mix of his past memories, new body, and strong stomach, he’s taking a bite out of this new fantastical world!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

The episodes were streamed several days ahead than the TV broadcast on U-NEXT, Anime Houdai, and Crunchyroll beginning on April 2nd, 2024 at 0:00 JST. The regular TV broadcast begins on April 5th, 2024.

node.description:
__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum
__Rank:__ Colonel/1st in the Goblin Community

Rou, whose former name was Tomokui Kanata, was a human with an esper ability. One day, he was killed by someone whom he regard as a sister and a stalker. Later, he woke to find out he was reincarnated as a goblin, a monster species considered to be of the lowest class. His memories as a human remained with him, however, and he had a second chance at life, Rou was determined to live his life to the fullest.

E is the Head of the logistical support group Pleasure and leader of the mining group. She was the first goblin to ask [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou) to train them. She was also placed 4th in the very first hierarchy tournament.

__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum 
__Rank:__ Major/3rd in the Goblin Community
__Corp:__ Tirard

Joined Rou's party after Kichi. She is the head of the Tirard Corps, dealing with long range weapons such as slingstaffs, bows, and cross-bows. Mi has an easy-going personality and has always wanted to be with Rou. She has been praising and complimenting Rou ever since they first spoke.

__Job(s):__ Farmer, Warrior, Noir Soldier

Rubellia Walline is a member of Parabellum and one of [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou)'s lovers, as well as Opushii's mother.

Rubellia was initially a rather shy and introverted young woman. She starts to become more assertive after joining Rou.

__Job(s):__ Peddler, Alchemist, Item Creator

Spinel Fean is an alchemist and a former member of the merchant association The Star God's Pavilion. She joined Parabellum as their chief alchemist and as one of [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou)'s lovers.

Intellectual type that works diligently on the tasks at hand. She was the first to express her feeling to Rou and sincerely thanked him for saving her from being raped.

__Affiliation:__ Goblin Community, Parabellum
__Rank:__ Lieutenant Colonel/2nd in the Goblin Community

Kichi is Rou's first goblin friend. He lacks intelligence but makes up for it with brute strength.

__Job(s):__ Peddler, Cook, Tailor

Alma Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin older sister [Felicia](https://anilist.co/character/305955/Timiano-Felicia). She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion.

She is gentle and shy. However, she becomes scary when she gets angry.

__Job(s):__ Peddler, Cook, Tailor

Felicia Timiano is a cook and a tailor like her twin younger sister [Alma Timiano](https://anilist.co/character/305960/Alma-Timiano). She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion.

She is gentle and a worrywart, however, she becomes scary when she gets angry.

__Job(s):__ Peddler, Appraiser, Smith

Emery Furado is a blacksmith and currently works for Parabellum. She is a former member of the merchant association Star God Pavilion.

She has a bright and cheerful disposition as well as a rather enviable affinity to working with spirit stones.

Sei is part of the generation before [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou). She was a hobgoblin mage when first introduced into the story. She later becomes the leader of Agony.

Sei is smart, has high wisdom, and has a cool head among her generation and her younger generation, as can be shown in the first conflict between Rou and Hobuken. She prefers to avoid pointless fighting and tends to not get into ranks of stronger goblins during non-magic competitions. She may go really far to attain her objectives. She has the habit to spend a lot of money to acquire Grimoires.

Sato was a goblin from the previous generation before [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou). She was with the group of older goblins and hobgoblins that captured the 5 female humans.

Sato is a joyous one, sometimes mocking Sei. But when she draws her sword she is unstoppable. ~!She became a Half Blood Lord because of her love for battle and swords.!~
She has the habit to spend a lot of money to acquire Swords.

Fu is one of the goblins from [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou)'s generation. Like Me, she at first is one of the minor members of Rou's group, ~!but later, after ranking up several times, her abilities allow her to stand out and she plays a much larger role as one of the 8 Demon Generals.!~

She seems to linger around after a hunt, snacking on and collecting meat that seems spoiled to others. She has an unusual laugh.

Jii was a goblin who managed to live until he attained the age of 20, a great elderly among goblins.

This pervert whose lust for younger girls, regardless of their race, and can't be satisfied even at his ripe old age.
That aside, he had shown to be very caring of his kin and a wise counselor.

Mail Failo Rheinfall is the daughter of the current Elf Chieftain.

She is quite shy and reserved however can become more outspoken when startled or stirred. She cares for her people and always wants to do what she believes is right.

__Job(s):__ Warrior, Knight, Templar Knight, Royal Knight

Therese East Eckermann was a knight of the Sternbild Kingdom before becoming a member of Parabellum.

She possesses a serious personality and is a hard worker. She can't stand having her efforts in strengthening being made light of.
~!She is also a woman of her word because she agreed to follow [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou) if he beat her, which is what inevitably happened.!~

Ji was the first to become a Cleric amongst those in Parabellum, ~!hence he became the leader of the medical corps, Prière.!~

Ji became a cleric upon ranking up into a Hobgoblin, which is a class that specializes in healing and protection abilities. ~!After he ranks up to a Half-Saint Lord, his skills are far stronger than before.!~

Doriane Duboué is a dryad who lived in the Kuuderun Great Forest.

Doriane has an easy-going personality and mainly only does things she finds interesting until she finds something else to do.

~![Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou) encountered Doriane as he was exploring a part of the Kuuderun Great Forest alone. She seduced him and tried to absorb him into her tree.!~

Returner was a Carbuncle that was created by the legendary Magician Velvet, who left it in charge of his treasures after he passed away.

Returner was discovered by [E](https://anilist.co/character/305869/E), who had accidentally broken into the Dungeon while mining.

Kirue was one the elves guarding the fool, along with her twin sister [Arue](https://anilist.co/character/306389/Arue), [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou) refers to them as “guard elves”.

She is one of two daughters from a good family with a splendid lineage. These two were elites who not only received training but also had crafting passed onto them by their lineage.

Arue was one the elves guarding the fool, along with her twin sister [Kirue](https://anilist.co/character/306388/Kirue). [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou) refers to them as “guard elves”.

~!After being captured by Rou's group, she and her sister were the last of the elves to sucumb. Some time latter they where put to work with dwarfs crafting mithril.!~
Esseba is the chairman of the "Round-Table Conference" that the head of 12 families living in the Elven Village set up to decide the future of their village. He's a considerably great Elf.

Akitainu is the leader of the Kobold Clan, and under [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/133061/Rou)'s command.

Akitainu is deeply loyal to Rou, and will follow his orders no matter how unreasonable or dangerous they may be.
